headline: Two o'clock thins the city.
body: A kettle clicks off in a window three floors up and nobody comes for it. The last bus has already pretended it will be back. Paper from a takeaway menu turns once in the gutter and settles.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: cloud stacked low, streetlamps doing the work

pulses.label: Mood
pulses.value: rooms still lit, voices already gone

pulses.label: Watch
pulses.value: the crossing beep delayed, then empty
